verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into an up Counter Strike (E); you win if you poke with Corrosive Charge (Q) and punish every Leap Strike (Q) with Disdain (E).

brief.thesis: This is a cooldown-reading lane, not a stat-check: Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q) outranges Jax at 800 vs his 700 Leap Strike (Q), but Jax's Counter Strike (E) negates every basic attack Urgot lands during its channel. Whoever tracks the other's dash/stun cooldown wins the exchange, and Urgot holds the long-term edge once Black Cleaver and a maxed Purge (W) come online. The 52% win rate over 1071 games and Urgot's solo-kill advantage confirm this is close but tilted slightly in Urgot's favor if played correctly.

theirWindow.what: Do not auto-attack into his stance window. He dodges all basic attacks during Counter Strike and then stuns and damages everyone around him when it resolves, so poke with Corrosive Charge (Q) instead of autos until it's confirmed spent.

yourWindow.when: Right after Jax burns Counter Strike (E)
yourWindow.what: Close in immediately with Disdain (E) and auto-weave with Purge (W). His E is down for 18 to 10 seconds depending on rank, and he has no stun or auto-dodge to stop your trade.

powerCurve.note: Neither has reliable engage or poke online yet.
Q range punishes Leap Strike's 17-11s cooldown.
Jax's R stacking and faster Counter Strike spike trades.
Black Cleaver online, Purge nearing low cooldown.

start.why: Taken in 87% of games at 52.6% win rate; the extra sustain and auto damage help you trade autos when Jax's Counter Strike (E) is down.

boots.why: 68.8% pick rate at 53.5% win rate; flat damage reduction blunts Jax's Relentless Assault (R) attack speed scaling and his empowered Leap Strike (Q) autos.

core.why: First item in the highest win-rate path (65% over 183 games); the armor shred lets your autos and Purge (W) chip through his stacked Equipment Mastery health.
Second item in that same path; the health and tenacity-adjacent shield keep you alive through his Counter Strike (E) stun window.
Completes the top build path (65% win rate, 21.4% pick); stacking resistances scales directly against his attack-speed-based damage output.

situational.when: he keeps catching you with Leap Strike (Q) before you can land Disdain (E)
the game goes long and you need more sustained damage in extended trades
he builds into heavy lifesteal or crit and out-sustains your trades

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken in the higher win-rate page (48.5% win rate, 29.6% pick); it rewards the auto-weave pattern you need between Corrosive Charge (Q) poke and Purge (W) follow-up.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 82% selection and 52.5% win rate; Ignite converts your measured solo-kill advantage into secured kills once Fear Beyond Death (R) drops them below execute threshold.

playing.title: Poke before he can leap
playing.detail: Open with Corrosive Charge (Q) at 800 range while Leap Strike (Q) is still on a 17 to 14 second cooldown at levels 1-3. He cannot punish this safely.

playing.title: Save Disdain for his leap
playing.detail: Hold Disdain (E) to catch Jax mid-Leap Strike (Q); it stops his engage and hurls him out of position before he reaches you.

playing.title: Never auto into an up Counter Strike
playing.detail: If his E is available, trade with Corrosive Charge (Q) only. Autoing in lets him dodge for free and then stun you when it resolves.

playing.title: All-in the instant his E is spent
playing.detail: Once Counter Strike (E) is confirmed down, close with Disdain (E) and unload Purge (W); he has no stun or dodge for the next 10-18 seconds.

playing.title: Clear with Purge, not just autos
playing.detail: Purge (W) prioritizes champions you've already struck, so land a Q first then hold W to melt both the wave and Jax simultaneously.

playing.title: Execute with R off cooldown checks
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death (R) has a 100 to 70 second cooldown; track it and only commit extended trades when it's up to guarantee the execute.

playing.title: Respect his level 6 spike
playing.detail: Relentless Assault (R) comes online at 6 and stacks attack speed each hit; disengage rather than extended-trade right as he hits that level.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG data on the current patch (16.19.1); the cooldown-reading tactics and power curve are my own read of the ability kits, not measured win-rate splits.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] when Jax closes in with (Q). Try to close in and fight him once (E) is on cooldown.
